notes: Layout: main airway I-J-E with 100 Pa across it, and a blind heading J-H (80 m, 5 × 5 m). A Ø760 mm duct (k = 0.003, no entry or exit loss) runs 72 m from J into the heading; the air it delivers returns along the heading to J. Same duct and 500 Pa fan as Lit 3, with leakage Lc = 20 m³/s per km at 1 kPa, a leak station every 18 m (Q_leak = Lc·L/1000·√(Δp/1000), the leakage law of the Vent Calcs workbook, ref R8 in the Duct tab). Checks: mass in = mass out + leakage mass; each leak obeys the law at its own pressure difference.

expected.basis: independent incompressible Newton solve of the same 3-station network: Qin 9.794, Qout 9.275, leakage 0.519 m³/s (the app differs by ≤0.2% because it follows the density change)
